candidates.description: Chip stock selloff stole the spotlight this week. The chip stock selloff dominated the week, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling for an eighth straight session, its longest streak since 2008, and the Nasdaq sliding 4.5%. Yet TSMC posted a record profit up nearly 69% and ASML booked record sales, so the businesses kept growing while the share prices fell. Hot US inflation, Brent near $110 on Hormuz risks and a silent Fed added to the pressure, while Singapore's index held at 5,415.5
candidates.headline: GoodWhale Weekly: Chip Stock Selloff Hits 8 Days, Oil Nears $110, Singapore Exports Surge 68%

candidates.description: STI bank selloff stole the spotlight this week. The STI bank selloff dominated the week in Singapore, with the index sliding about 4.1% to 5,401.89 as OCBC, UOB and DBS tumbled on Wednesday and Thursday. The trigger was global: the US 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.364%, a 24-year high, while Fed minutes showed most officials still expect one more hike. AI chips fell after an OpenAI revenue scare, Brent climbed to $104.72, and SpaceX's spectrum purchase knocked about 9% off the US telecom giants.
candidates.headline: GoodWhale Weekly: STI Bank Selloff Wipes 4.1%, Yields Hit a 24-Year High, AI Chips Wobble

companies.Flexxon: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore cybersecurity-hardware startup (founded 2007) building X-PHY, the world's first AI-embedded SSD with hardware-level threat detection and physical-tamper response. Co-founded by Camellia Chan and May Chng. Drop items that only mention generic flash-storage or unrelated 'X-PHY' physics content.
companies.Forte Biotech: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore biotech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Goodwhale: BLOCK71 Social Impact Hub-resident Singapore B-Corp-certified fintech startup running a personalised investing-health platform for new retail investors — goal setting, portfolio coaching, sustainable / values-aligned investing tools. Drop pet/animal-care 'whale' brands or shipping news unless the article references the investing-health platform.
companies.Pinhome: BLOCK71 Bandung-listed Indonesian end-to-end proptech (founded January 2020 by ex-Gojek execs Dayu Dara Permata and Ahmed Aljunied): home search, transactions, conventional + sharia mortgage and refinancing, plus PinHome Home Service for cleaning, car wash and home maintenance. 1M+ housing inventories, 20+ banking partners. Generic 'pin home' wording — drop unrelated Pinterest / home-decor mentions.
companies.Skuling: BLOCK71 Yogyakarta-resident Indonesian edutech startup building a gamified web learning platform — leaderboards, social discussion, performance analytics — targeting Indonesian primary/secondary education accessibility and engagement gaps. ~110,000 users across 502 of 514 Indonesian cities. Founded by Yudha Pratama Situmorang (Boston University Questrom MBA'24); 2024 Poets & Quants Most Disruptive MBA Startup. Drop generic 'schooling' / education-tech mentions.
